detail_html:
⭐Who are We

Simplus provides high quality home appliances for all customers in South East Asia. We produce well-designed, reliable, easy-to-use and cost-effective smart products to make life up easily. From personal healthy to home improvement, we help you make the most out of every day.

⭐Product Features

1.  5-in-1 Styler for Wet & Dry Hair: Combines drying, smoothing, straightening, curling, and volumizing in one tool for all your daily styling needs.

2.  450M High-Concentration Negative Ions: Effectively neutralizes static, tames frizz, and boosts shine for sleek, smooth hair. Styling while caring for your hair (see comparison chart for emphasis).

3.  Unique Large Oval Brush, 2-in-1 Barrel & Straightener Design: Creates natural-looking voluminous curls with less pulling, protecting hair strands. Functions as a dryer, smoother, curler, straightener, and volumizer.

4.  Dual-Brush Design: Denser, shorter bristles lift roots for strong grip and efficient styling; soft silicone tips massage the scalp and prevent burns.

5.  Hairdryer + 360° Airflow + Reverse Airflow + 32,000 RPM High-Speed Motor: Upgraded powerful airflow for fast drying. 360° airflow from the inside out penetrates hair more easily for incredible volume.

6.  Durable Pure Copper Motor: Ensures long-lasting, stable performance and extended product lifespan.

7.  3 Mode Settings: C - Style Set Mode (Cool Air, 40°C); 1 - Styling Mode (Warm Air, 60°C); 2 - Drying Mode (Hot Air, 80°C). Meets different needs and suits various hair types.

8.  Constant Temperature Protection: Prevents heat damage for smoother, silkier hair and salon-quality results.

9.  Versatile Styling: Easily creates voluminous flipped-in ends, curls, straight styles, and lifted roots.

10. Heat-Safe Top Handle: Allows for a secure grip during styling, prevents hand burns, and is easy to detach.

11. 360° Swivel Cord: Rotates smoothly during use to prevent cable tangles.

12. 1.8m Extra-Long Power Cord: Provides convenient, unrestricted use.

13. Removable Air Intake Filter: Allows for easy periodic cleaning of dust from the intake, aiding long-term maintenance and consistent airflow.

14. Safety-Compliant Plug & Power Cord: Plug meets safety standards; pure copper wire core eliminates potential hazards.

15. Cable Hook Design: A user-friendly feature for easier storage.

16. Slide & Lock Mechanism: Makes attachment and detachment quick and easy.

⭐ Simplus After-Sales Policy

- Customers have the option to return/refund the product if they are dissatisfied with it or if it has quality issues after 15 days of receiving it, along with images and reasoning.

- Returns are not accepted for used, damaged, or non-resalable items.

- If you encounter a warehouse error or send incomplete product parts, please notify the customer care via live chat, and we will resolve the issue for the customer as quickly as possible.

- If the buyer keeps the device for more than 15 days, Simplus provides a one-year warranty (exchange only, no repair). The customer must be a simplus member and can reach out to customer care via live chat for more details on the Simplus one-year guarantee and scope of use.

⭐ Note

- When unboxing the package, customers should photograph the goods to expedite after-sales handling if there is an issue with it.

- The one-year guarantee may only be used once per order.

- If an order is returned for reasons other than product quality, the client is liable for the return shipping expenses.

title: Tangle Teezer The Ultimate Detangler Regular Hairbrush (Straight & Curly/Fine & Fragile/Curly & Coily)
detail_text: Designed for use on wet hair. 0The Ultimate Detangler effortlessly slips through your hair (and thanks to its handle, not out of your wet hands). The patented two-tiered teeth technology is gentle on vulnerable, shower-fresh hair, meaning less breakage, more of that running-your-fingers-through-your-hair feeling. The long teeth detangle, while the shorter teeth smooth - a team effort at its finest. Treating your locks to a conditioning treatment? Use The Ultimate Detangler to evenly draw your products of choice through the lengths of your hair. 4 Types: • straight - curly (SC) • fine & fragile (FF) • curly & coily (CC) • extra gentle (EG) ✔ Straight & Curly (SC) comes with regular-flex teeth that is ideal for straight to curly hair type ✔ Fine & Fragile (FF) comes with soft-flex teeth that are extra-gentle for fine and fragile hair type ✔ Curly & Coily (CC) comes with firm-flex teeth that detangles all types of naturally curly and coily hair, 3C to 4C ✔ Extra Gentle (EG) comes with unique wide-spaced teeth pattern is extra gentle on delicate hair prone to breakage Plant Version: Made from 85% sustainably sourced castor beans. Kinder to the planet. Why Tangle Teezer Ultimate Detangler Hairbrush ✓ Designed to use for wet hair and in the shower ✓ Reduces breakage and leaves hair healthier-looking ✓ Glide effortlessly through all types of wet hair, no pulling, tugging or snagging. ✓ Patented two-tiered teeth technology with added flex for wet hair ✓ Long, flexible teeth detangle, removing knots and reducing breakage ✓ Short teeth smooth, for glossy, frizz-free hair. ✓ Use it in the shower to brush through and distribute shampoo and conditioner ✓ Comfortable and slim, non-slip handle for great grip ** DO NOT USE WITH HEAT ** How To Clean? 1. Take your Tangle Teezer and lift any loose hair from the teeth 2. Fill a small bowl with warm soapy water 3. Taking an old, but clean toothbrush, dip into the water 4. Gently brush between the teeth until any product build-up is removed from the teeth and the base of the hairbrush 4. Leave the brush to air dry naturally with the teeth facing upwards. WILL HEAT DAMAGE MY TANGLE TEEZER? We advise that the hairbrushes in our Detangling and Finishing range should not be used with heat, as this can cause the teeth to melt. The tools in our Blow-Styling range have been specifically designed for blow-styling which can be used with heat.
detail_html:
Designed for use on wet hair. 0The Ultimate Detangler effortlessly slips through your hair (and thanks to its handle, not out of your wet hands). The patented two-tiered teeth technology is gentle on vulnerable, shower-fresh hair, meaning less breakage, more of that running-your-fingers-through-your-hair feeling. The long teeth detangle, while the shorter teeth smooth - a team effort at its finest. Treating your locks to a conditioning treatment? Use The Ultimate Detangler to evenly draw your products of choice through the lengths of your hair. 

4 Types:

• straight - curly (SC)

• fine & fragile (FF)

• curly & coily (CC)

• extra gentle (EG)

✔ Straight & Curly (SC) comes with regular-flex teeth that is ideal for straight to curly hair type

✔ Fine & Fragile (FF) comes with soft-flex teeth that are extra-gentle for fine and fragile hair type

✔ Curly & Coily (CC) comes with firm-flex teeth that detangles all types of naturally curly and coily hair, 3C to 4C

✔ Extra Gentle (EG) comes with unique wide-spaced teeth pattern is extra gentle on delicate hair prone to breakage

Plant Version: Made from 85% sustainably sourced castor beans. Kinder to the planet. 

Why Tangle Teezer Ultimate Detangler Hairbrush

✓ Designed to use for wet hair and in the shower

✓ Reduces breakage and leaves hair healthier-looking

✓ Glide effortlessly through all types of wet hair, no pulling, tugging or snagging.

✓ Patented two-tiered teeth technology with added flex for wet hair

✓ Long, flexible teeth detangle, removing knots and reducing breakage

✓ Short teeth smooth, for glossy, frizz-free hair.

✓ Use it in the shower to brush through and distribute shampoo and conditioner

✓ Comfortable and slim, non-slip handle for great grip

** DO NOT USE WITH HEAT **

How To Clean?

1. Take your Tangle Teezer and lift any loose hair from the teeth

2. Fill a small bowl with warm soapy water

3. Taking an old, but clean toothbrush, dip into the water

4. Gently brush between the teeth until any product build-up is removed from the teeth and the base of the hairbrush

4. Leave the brush to air dry naturally with the teeth facing upwards.

WILL HEAT DAMAGE MY TANGLE TEEZER?

We advise that the hairbrushes in our Detangling and Finishing range should not be used with heat, as this can cause the teeth to melt. The tools in our Blow-Styling range have been specifically designed for blow-styling which can be used with heat.

brand.name: Tangle Teezer
brand.suggestion: More Personal Care from Tangle Teezer

product.desc:
Designed for use on wet hair. 0The Ultimate Detangler effortlessly slips through your hair (and thanks to its handle, not out of your wet hands). The patented two-tiered teeth technology is gentle on vulnerable, shower-fresh hair, meaning less breakage, more of that running-your-fingers-through-your-hair feeling. The long teeth detangle, while the shorter teeth smooth - a team effort at its finest. Treating your locks to a conditioning treatment? Use The Ultimate Detangler to evenly draw your products of choice through the lengths of your hair. 

4 Types:

• straight - curly (SC)

• fine & fragile (FF)

• curly & coily (CC)

• extra gentle (EG)

✔ Straight & Curly (SC) comes with regular-flex teeth that is ideal for straight to curly hair type

✔ Fine & Fragile (FF) comes with soft-flex teeth that are extra-gentle for fine and fragile hair type

✔ Curly & Coily (CC) comes with firm-flex teeth that detangles all types of naturally curly and coily hair, 3C to 4C

✔ Extra Gentle (EG) comes with unique wide-spaced teeth pattern is extra gentle on delicate hair prone to breakage

Plant Version: Made from 85% sustainably sourced castor beans. Kinder to the planet. 

Why Tangle Teezer Ultimate Detangler Hairbrush

✓ Designed to use for wet hair and in the shower

✓ Reduces breakage and leaves hair healthier-looking

✓ Glide effortlessly through all types of wet hair, no pulling, tugging or snagging.

✓ Patented two-tiered teeth technology with added flex for wet hair

✓ Long, flexible teeth detangle, removing knots and reducing breakage

✓ Short teeth smooth, for glossy, frizz-free hair.

✓ Use it in the shower to brush through and distribute shampoo and conditioner

✓ Comfortable and slim, non-slip handle for great grip

** DO NOT USE WITH HEAT **

How To Clean?

1. Take your Tangle Teezer and lift any loose hair from the teeth

2. Fill a small bowl with warm soapy water

3. Taking an old, but clean toothbrush, dip into the water

4. Gently brush between the teeth until any product build-up is removed from the teeth and the base of the hairbrush

4. Leave the brush to air dry naturally with the teeth facing upwards.

WILL HEAT DAMAGE MY TANGLE TEEZER?

We advise that the hairbrushes in our Detangling and Finishing range should not be used with heat, as this can cause the teeth to melt. The tools in our Blow-Styling range have been specifically designed for blow-styling which can be used with heat.

TYPE 1

Features:

1.This electric scalp massage comb features three light therapies: red, blue, and purple lights target specific scalp needs. 8 LED beads deliver light precisely to soothe scalp, revitalizing follicles and improving overall scalp health.
2. Equipped with an HD display screen, the scalp massaging brush displays real-time massage intensity and modes. Enable personalized adjustments through its intuitive controls.
3. Featuring a 6ml liquid reservoir, the hair comb ensures even distribution of essential oils through 6 conducting liquid roller balls. It deeply nourishes scalp, helps nutrient penetration, and improves nursing effect.
4. With 72 massage comb teeth, the hair oil applicator delivers a 360°grab and knead massage. Multiple pressure points stimulate blood circulation, relieving tension and reinvigorating the scalp.
5. The anti hair loss massager offers five intelligent adjustment levels, ranging from gentle soothing to deep tissue kneading. Mimicking professional massagist techniques, it caters to various comfort levels, ensuring an unparalleled massage experience.

TYPE 2

Features:

1.This electric head massager features three unique grab-and-knead modes: Wake-Up Mode (red light) — quick combing with acupoint stimulation; Relaxation Mode (green light) — gentle kneading to enhance scalp micro-circulation; and Sleep Prep Mode (blue light) — alternating fast and slow speeds to ease tension and promote deeper sleep.
2.Equipped with 8 micro-current teeth and three adjustable intensity levels — Level 1 (red), Level 2 (blue), and Level 3 (green) — this hair growth comb stimulates the scalp through kneading motions. The scalp relax massager glides along meridians, opens pressure points, and decompresses the head, strengthening hair roots to stabilize hair density.
3.The scalp relax massager boasts 72 rounded comb teeth that deeply knead the scalp for thicker, fuller hair. Combined with 660nm red LED therapy, it activates follicles, boosts absorption of hair serums, and balances scalp oil production — effectively combating hair loss.
4.This hair care hairbrush includes a detachable liquid reservoir and 6 elastic roller beads that evenly dispense nourishing oils without leaks. No more messy hands — it massages while infusing serums, replacing traditional manual application.
5.The electric kneading massage comb boosts blood circulation, tightens the scalp, and targets multiple concerns.

TYPE 3

Features:

1.This hair massage comb effectively tightens the scalp, provides deep care for a variety of scalp problems, and promotes scalp health.
2.Equipped with 72 round teeth and 630nm wavelength red light, our massage comb can effectively knead and massage the scalp, deeply nourish the hair roots, and help you create lush and luxuriant hair.
3.Three scalp massage modes are available, which can help promote scalp micro-circulation, soothe nerves, help sleep, and bring a more comfortable rest experience.
4.The 6ML large-capacity liquid guide tank and 8 roller balls design help to evenly squeeze out the hair care liquid, so that the hair growth care liquid can be introduced while massaging the scalp, nourishing the scalp and hair in all directions.

The Compact Styler is a travel-friendly, handbag-ready detangling brush designed to smooth, shine, and define hair anytime, anywhere. Perfect for fine to medium hair, its two-tiered flexible teeth glide gently through strands, reducing breakage while leaving hair polished and manageable. The protective click-on cover keeps teeth safe in your bag, making it ideal for on-the-go styling and finishing. Compact and lightweight, this brush is the ultimate hair tool for busy lifestyles. detail_html:
Scalp Massage Comb



Feature

1.Press out liquid. Accurate control of drug quantity, refuse to waste drugs. 8 liquid outlet comb, press out liquid. 72 round comb teeth, intensive scratching and kneading.


2.Silky liquid. The ball fit scalp, high elastic skin affinity, 8 liquid out column evenly liquid, each gear evenly size, so that each hair root evenly absorb drugs.


3.Double drug absorption. 630nm infrared light, directly reaching the roots of 3-5MM hair follicles, awakens healthy hair roots from the source, regulates scalp water and oil balance, while soothing the scalp to promote scalp absorption of drugs.


4.True Scratching and Kneading Massage. A scratching and lifting, making the scalp tingle and firm, combing through the scalp, promoting scalp micro-circulation.


5.Relieve fatigue. Three massage methods, imitating finger pressure grip, quickly remove scalp tightness.


6.6ml large capacity liquid tank. Simple operation and convenient to clean.


7.Triple effect. Improve the scalp environment away from hair sub-health.

① Scalp care. The micro current compacts the scalp and promotes absorption.

② Plump and dense Hair. Red light penetrates deep into the base, promotes circulation to care for the hair root.

③ Scratching massage. Grab and lift the scalp, comb through the scalp meridians.


8. Compact and lightweight. Whether you're out, traveling or at home, you can use it anytime, anywhere.


9. IPX7 waterproof. Dry and wet dual use, the head can be directly flushed, regular cleaning can prevent clogging.


10. Long battery life. Battery content 1400mAh, charging time 3 hours, using time 40-60 minutes, smart timing 10 minutes.

Input voltage: 5V1A
Rated voltage: 3.7V
Rated power: 5W
Smart timing: 10 minutes
Battery content: 1400mAh

Using time: 45-60 minutes

red light always on (fully charged)

detail_text: ABOUT THE PRODUCT: Scalp Revitalization Tool : This innovative Massage Hair Brush features gentle bristles combined with light therapy technology, designed to stimulate the scalp and improve blood circulation. It promotes healthier, smoother hair by enhancing the flow of nutrients to the hair follicles. Perfect for daily use, it helps to reduce stress, soothe tension, and boost overall scalp health. Therapeutic Scalp Massager : This Scalp Head Massage Comb offers a luxurious, spa-like experience at home. Equipped with light therapy and soft massaging bristles, it helps to improve blood flow to your scalp, encouraging hair growth and making your hair feel silky smooth. The gentle vibrations provide stress relief while stimulating healthy hair follicles for a revitalized scalp. Light Therapy & Scalp Care in One : Designed to promote better blood circulation, this Massage Hair Brush uses light therapy to rejuvenate your scalp. The soft massaging comb not only improves hair texture by making it smoother and shinier, but also helps reduce scalp tension and encourages healthier hair growth. An essential tool for anyone seeking a more vibrant, nourished scalp. Smooth & Healthy Hair : This advanced Scalp Head Massage Comb combines the benefits of light therapy and a soft massager to enhance circulation and improve the condition of your hair. Regular use encourages the nourishment of hair follicles, helping to reduce hair thinning and promote thicker, shinier hair. The ergonomic design makes it comfortable to use and ideal for everyday relaxation. Dual Action Scalp Stimulator : Featuring both soft massaging bristles and light therapy, this Hair Brush is designed to improve scalp health and blood circulation. The massage helps to alleviate tension while the light therapy works to stimulate hair follicles, resulting in smoother, stronger, and more manageable hair. It’s the perfect way to pamper your scalp while promoting healthier hair from the root up. PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS: Material: ABS Power supply: USB Gear: 3 gears Using frequency: 2-4 times per day Using time: 3-4 hours Charging time: 4 hours Item size: 18x4.2cm Color: White Package List: * 1 x Massage hair brush * 1 x USB cable Happy Shopping!

detail_text: Tangle Teezer The Ultimate Detangler Hairbrush is a detangling hairbrush for wet hair. The Ultimate Detangler effortlessly slips through your hair (and thanks to its handle, not out of your wet hands). The patented two-tiered teeth technology is gentle on vulnerable, shower-fresh hair, meaning less breakage, more of that running-your-fingers-through-your-hair feeling. The long teeth detangle, while the shorter teeth smooth - a team effort at its finest. Treating your locks to a conditioning treatment? Use The Ultimate Detangler to evenly draw your products of choice through the lengths of your hair. 2 Types: • Straight - Curly (SC) • Naturally Curly (NC) ✔ Straight - Curly (SC) comes with regular-flex teeth that is suitable for all straight to curly hair ✔ Naturally Curly (NC) comes with longer, firmer teeth are kind to curls but tough on tangles and the shorter teeth help to reduce the level of frizz. Suitable for 3c to 4c hair types • Designed to use for wet hair and in the shower • Reduces breakage and leaves hair healthier-looking • Glide effortlessly through all types of wet hair, no pulling, tugging or snagging. • Patented two-tiered teeth technology with added flex for wet hair • Long, flexible teeth detangle, removing knots and reducing breakage • Short teeth smooth, for glossy, frizz-free hair. • Use it in the shower to brush through and distribute shampoo and conditioner • Comfortable and slim, non-slip handle for great grip • DO NOT USE WITH HEAT Our patented teeth have two-tiered technology with added flex for wet hair. The long, flexible teeth detangle, removing knots and reducing breakage, while the short teeth smooth, for glossy, frizz-free hair. * 80% Fewer knots and tangles * 82% Would recommend to a friend * Up to 433 Flexible teeth * 97% Gentler on the scalp 5 STEPS TO CLEAN YOUR TANGLE TEEZER Take your Tangle Teezer and lift any loose hair from the teeth Fill a small bowl with warm soapy water Taking an old, but clean toothbrush, dip into the water Gently brush between the teeth until any product build-up is removed from the teeth and the base of the hairbrush Leave the brush to air dry naturally with the teeth facing upwards.
detail_html:
Tangle Teezer The Ultimate Detangler Hairbrush is a detangling hairbrush for wet hair. The Ultimate Detangler effortlessly slips through your hair (and thanks to its handle, not out of your wet hands). The patented two-tiered teeth technology is gentle on vulnerable, shower-fresh hair, meaning less breakage, more of that running-your-fingers-through-your-hair feeling. The long teeth detangle, while the shorter teeth smooth - a team effort at its finest. Treating your locks to a conditioning treatment? Use The Ultimate Detangler to evenly draw your products of choice through the lengths of your hair.

2 Types:

• Straight - Curly (SC)

• Naturally Curly (NC)

✔ Straight - Curly (SC) comes with regular-flex teeth that is suitable for all straight to curly hair

✔ Naturally Curly (NC) comes with longer, firmer teeth are kind to curls but tough on tangles and the shorter teeth help to reduce the level of frizz. Suitable for 3c to 4c hair types

• Designed to use for wet hair and in the shower

• Reduces breakage and leaves hair healthier-looking

• Glide effortlessly through all types of wet hair, no pulling, tugging or snagging.

• Patented two-tiered teeth technology with added flex for wet hair

• Long, flexible teeth detangle, removing knots and reducing breakage

• Short teeth smooth, for glossy, frizz-free hair.

• Use it in the shower to brush through and distribute shampoo and conditioner

• Comfortable and slim, non-slip handle for great grip

• DO NOT USE WITH HEAT

Our patented teeth have two-tiered technology with added flex for wet hair. The long, flexible teeth detangle, removing knots and reducing breakage, while the short teeth smooth, for glossy, frizz-free hair.

* 80% Fewer knots and tangles

* 82% Would recommend to a friend

* Up to 433 Flexible teeth

* 97% Gentler on the scalp

5 STEPS TO CLEAN YOUR TANGLE TEEZER

Take your Tangle Teezer and lift any loose hair from the teeth

Fill a small bowl with warm soapy water

Taking an old, but clean toothbrush, dip into the water

Gently brush between the teeth until any product build-up is removed from the teeth and the base of the hairbrush

Leave the brush to air dry naturally with the teeth facing upwards.

title: EYECANDY Rainbow Volume Styling Brush (Medium Pink)
detail_text: The EyeCandy Rainbow Volume Brush tames hair and prevents tangled and messy hair with specially designed wavy s-curl bristles. The teeth of the comb follow the curvature of the hair to minimise friction and restore softness and shine. Air volume is through the Air Holes in the bristles formed by S-curl Brush, creating a lightweight and natural volume each time you brush. Suitable for all hair types. The EyeCandy Rainbow Volume Brush is the world's first patented product featuring the S Curl brush teeth to make fine or thinning hair appear fuller, ease scalp irritation, detangle and leave your hair soft and shiny. It's like a volumising spray in a brush! Direction for use: Brush or style hair as required. To add extra volume, hang your head upside down and brush the hair from the roots several times.

title: Aveda Wooden Paddle Brush - Standard & Mini Size
detail_text: Product description Originally created for scalp treatments and detangling, this professional brush features extended bristles that stimulate and massage the scalp. Aveda Wooden Paddle Brush reduces stress to hair and scalp during blow-drying and styling. - Creates a relaxing scalp massage when used with Aveda Beautifying Composition, Energising Composition and Calming Composition. - Lightweight. Directions Aveda Tips: - Apply any Aveda styling product to shoulder length damp hair and blow dry using the large flat surface of the Aveda Wooden Paddle Brush to flatten the hair. - Keep your brush clean: after removing any excess hair, soak your brush in warm water with a bit of Aveda Hair Detoxifier. Rinse in clean water, shake dry or pat with a towel, then place bristle-side down on a towel to air dry.
